tools.hand_off_to: Ask a background worker to start or control work and return its current receipt; this tool does not perform the selected task itself. Each worker receives its authorized capability projection independently from this conversation's direct catalog. For work requiring a capability not callable here, hand off the original selected input within the user's execution and consultation limits. The worker discovers the live prerequisite or returns the actual blocker; a missing direct tool does not establish worker inability. Start accepts selected input as one background assignment; select sourceOrdinals for start and guidance actions when multiple current inputs exist. When one selected input contains separate objectives, set optional instruction to only the exact verbatim clause assigned to this worker. Omit instruction to assign the whole selected input. Preserve the objective's conditions, limits and output requirements. Conditions stated elsewhere in the selected original input remain visible to the worker as applicable context; do not assign other objectives to include them in the clause. Never paraphrase or summarize it; the source owner validates the exact selection. The runtime gives the worker the original selected input and inherited conversation; do not rewrite a brief. For existing work use its exact workRef and an available action: queue, message, steer, pause, resume, stop, retry or dismiss. Use list_workers only when the target or action is unclear. The original current input supplies guidance for queue, message, steer and retry. nativeInput answers an exact pending native question or permission using resume. Acknowledge work naturally only after the receipt confirms acceptance. The receipt proves acceptance of background work only; a claim that the requested effect occurred requires result evidence. Do not wait for completion.

instruction_selection: Optional exact, verbatim clause from the selected original input for this one worker. Use it to separate objectives inside one message; other conversation text remains shared context. Omit it to assign the whole selected input. Do not write a summary or a new instruction. Preserve the goal and output requirements. Conditions and limits elsewhere in the selected original input remain applicable context for this objective; do not include other objectives just to repeat those conditions in the clause.
